title: Native classification
description: NT-04c: <run>/classify.json, every slide and file-level finding of a native run classified against the known differences and a baseline summary. scripts/native-acceptance/core/classify/README.md explains the rule.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this format. Always 1.

target.description: The application the run opened the files in.

application.description: The application as run.json names it.

opf.description: The OPF that exported the files.

tier.description: The run's tier, null for a run that was not a tier run.

baseline.description: The baseline summary the run was classified against (its OPF version and date), null when none.

threshold.description: T: a score at or below it is no visible difference.

tolerance.description: How far a score may move from the baseline's and still count as unchanged.

knownBefore.description: When set, only the known records first seen before this OPF version were used.

look.description: How many deck#slide entries a change named to look at (each is new whatever its score).

new.description: New slides plus new findings: the run's exit is 1 when this is above 0.

export.description: NT-13: what the exported file draws, as hashes (scripts/native-acceptance/core/select/slide-parts.mjs, the first 16 hex digits of a SHA-256). deck covers the parts every slide shares (masters, the layouts slides use, theme, presentation properties); slides has one hash per slide, over the slide part and every part it reaches (charts, diagrams, pictures, media, notes, tags). A release candidate opens only the files whose hashes differ.

changed.description: NT-13: the slide's export hash differs from the baseline's (or the deck hash does, or the baseline lacks the file). Present only when the baseline has export hashes.

direction.description: For a slide whose score moved since the baseline: up (more differs) or down (less differs: usually a fix or an improvement, which someone confirms and then retires or narrows the record).

notes.description: What was not compared and why (for example the exported content changed since the baseline, so outcome counts were not compared).

kind.description: open not done; an import-warning line; a failed import of the application's copy; object outcomes that differ from the baseline's.

knownGone.description: Every record that names a slide whose score is at or below the threshold: the difference no longer shows there.
